description: This file implements an in-memory grain storage provider for Orleans, primarily intended for development and testing purposes. It provides methods for reading, writing, and clearing grain state asynchronously, using internal serialization mechanisms and memory-based storage. The class manages multiple storage grains and includes detailed logging.

classes.name: MemoryGrainStorage
classes.description: A simple in-memory implementation of IGrainStorage, supporting basic operations like read, write, and clear, with optional serialization.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads the state of a specified grain asynchronously, deserializing stored data into the grain state object.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Serializes and writes the current state of a grain asynchronously, updating its storage.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Clears the state of a specified grain asynchronously, resetting its stored data.

methods.name: ConvertFromStorageFormat
methods.description: Deserializes binary data into the specified generic type.

methods.name: ConvertToStorageFormat
methods.description: Serializes grain state into a binary format suitable for storage.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of a specified type using the activator provider.
